UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and notification alert preferences stored privately per user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Email address associated with the user account.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the LootRadar header and library.

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used to sign in.

pushEnabled.description: Whether push alerts are enabled for 100% off games.

notifyStores.description: List of store IDs enabled for instant giveaway alerts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

ClaimedGameRecord.title: ClaimedGameRecord
ClaimedGameRecord.description: Record of a 100% off game claimed by the user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who claimed the game.

gameId.description: Normalized alphanumeric ID of the claimed game.

store.description: Store identifier where the game was claimed.

originalPrice.description: Original retail price in USD saved by claiming the game.

claimUrl.description: Direct store URL of the claimed game.

coverImage.description: Cover artwork URL for the claimed game.

claimedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the user claimed the game.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the claim record was written.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and alert settings document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/claims/{claimId}.description: Subcollection of games marked as claimed by the user.
